subject: Invoice submission: web portal vs SMTP fallback + template clarifications
messages:
From: Amanda Li <accounts-payable@greenfield.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: ap@greenfield.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on invoice submission channel and sample template

Hi Aditya —

We're kicking off vendor setup for Greenfield's pilot and wanted to confirm your preferred invoice intake channel. Our AP team can: 

- Submit via your web portal (we can bulk upload CSV/XLSX)
- Email invoices to a dedicated address (ap@redwood-invoices.com) with PDFs attached
- Use SFTP dropbox if you prefer automatic pulls

A couple of clarifying questions before we onboard:
1) If we email invoices, do you require PO number in subject line or embedded on line items?
2) For portal uploads, is there a minimal line-item schema we should follow (unit_price, qty, tax_code)?
3) Any filename conventions or checksum expectations we should follow for automated ingest?

I've attached our invoice sample and the template we usually use. Happy to adapt — we just want to avoid delays on first runs.

Thanks,
Amanda Li
Accounts Payable Manager
Greenfield Robotics
[Attachment: GF_Invoice_Template_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: sample-invoice.pdf (pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <accounts-payable@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice submission channel and sample template

Amanda —

Thanks for the clear note and attachments. Short version: we prefer the portal for production onboarding (better visibility & ack tokens), but email is an accepted fallback for early suppliers. A quick run-through below: 

Portal (preferred for go-live)
- Bulk XLSX/CSV upload supported; portal validates PO numbers and line-item matching during ingest.
- Required fields: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number (if PO-backed), line_description, qty, unit_price, currency
- Optional: tax_code, ship_to_location. If tax is omitted we default to USD/no-tax for pilot unless otherwise instructed.
- Filenames: freeform, but include vendor id and invoice number if possible (e.g., GF-INV-12345.xlsx)

Email fallback (accepted for early runs)
- Send to ap@redwood-invoices.com; put PO# in subject as "PO: 12345" and the invoice_number in the body.
- Attach PDF or small XLSX. Max single attachment 10MB.
- We do a best-effort parse of PDFs; structured fields reduce errors.

SFTP (rare)
- We can support on request; will need public key exchange and a naming convention.

Next steps: Monica will share the portal CSV template with a sample line mapping and a simple validation checklist. If you're starting via email, include the sample invoice PDF and we'll run a test ingest and share the ack log.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Procurement Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <accounts-payable@greenfield.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice submission channel and sample template

Amanda —

Attaching the portal CSV template and a minimal line-item example. A few pragmatic notes from ops: 
- Use a separate row per line item; totals should be provided on a header row only.
- If multiple POs are covered on a single invoice, include po_number on each line row.
- For pilot, we strongly recommend one currency per file. Mixed-currency files cause manual reconciliation.

Exceptions we handle manually: credit memos, invoices without PO (we route to GL-approval), and invoices with >10 line items (may be subject to sampling). For any exception we generate an ack with an exception code and a human-friendly reason.

I'll follow up with a short preflight checklist you can run locally before sending (filename conventions, CSV encoding, date format).

Attachment: portal-upload-template.csv

Monica
Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Li <accounts-payable@greenfield.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice submission channel and sample template

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups after reviewing your template: 
- We have a legacy billing system that exports CSV with line_description but no separate tax_code column. Will that block portal ingest?
- We sometimes combine two small POs on a single invoice PDF to reduce processing overhead. Is that allowable if we repeat each PO on the relevant line items?

I'll run a test via email first thing tomorrow and include the PO number in the subject. Please confirm the expected test ack format so we can validate parsing on our side.

Cheers,
Amanda

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <accounts-payable@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice submission channel and sample template

Amanda —

Quick answers so your tester can run tonight: 
1) Missing tax_code is not a hard block for portal ingest during the pilot; our uploader will accept blank and flag it with warning code W-210. It will still create an ack. For production rollouts we prefer the column present.
2) Combining multiple POs on one invoice is fine if each po_number is present on the corresponding line rows; we match line-level PO numbers. If a single line is billed to multiple POs that will require manual split.

Expected email ack: when you email ap@redwood-invoices.com we return an automated ack within 10 minutes with the following payload in the body: 
- ack_id: alphanumeric token
- parsed_invoice_number: string (as read)
- matched_po_numbers: comma-separated list
- status: accepted | accepted_with_warnings | exception
- exceptions: (only present if status=exception) short codes and description

I'll email back a test ack example and the portal validator checklist in a separate message. Looking forward to the test.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: example-ack-mail.txt (txt)]
